answer: The registry accepts a WebAuthn passkey link only through a rotating nonce chain. Each proof links to the previous nonce, forming a chain only the owner can extend, and the registry checks the answer before the identity is recorded. The vine that seals the link is the verified response; a vault of doubt reopens the check, and a knoll of failed answers bars the claim, so an agent cannot register a WebAuthn passkey belonging to someone else.
